record.notes: A chair's summary, not a negotiated outcome: the Co-Chairs state that the themes it records do not constitute negotiated outcomes or consensus positions. It covers the 6-7 July 2026 session and was released on 8 September 2026. The Scientific Panel presented its Preliminary Report (UN-08) at the session, and the AI Dialogue Partnerships Hub showcased more than 350 commitments, announcements and initiatives. The second Dialogue is to be held in New York on 3-4 May 2027, back-to-back with the Multi-stakeholder Forum on Science, Technology and Innovation for the Sustainable Development Goals.

verification.note: Stored copies (un.org): the Co-Chairs' Summary PDF (18 pages, stored 11 Oct 2026; the archiver found it unchanged on 17 Oct 2026) and the AI Dialogue home page, the record's secondary source, stored on 11 and 17 Oct 2026. The PDF confirms the title, the session dates and venue, the participation figures, the co-chairs, the Joint Secretariat, the four areas of convergence and the cluster findings; it states no issue date. The 17 Oct 2026 copy of the AI Dialogue page says the summary was 'released 8 September 2026', which gives the date at alt-official level because the page is the record's secondary source; it also confirms the 3-4 May 2027 second session. The sentence on the BRICS AI statement was dropped from the notes because no stored source of this record supports it.

issuing_body.quote: The AI Dialogue was co-chaired by H.E. Ms Egriselda López, Permanent Representative of the Republic of El Salvador, and H.E. Mr Rein Tammsaar, Permanent Representative of the Republic of Estonia.
The Co-Chairs were supported by a Joint Secretariat comprising ITU, UNESCO, together with UN ODET and with support from the EOSG. ITU and UNESCO coordinated the Joint Secretariat.

judgment.status_reasoning: The Co-Chairs' Summary of the 2026 session was released on 8 September 2026 (AI Dialogue page, 17 Oct 2026 copy) and nothing has replaced it; the next session, in May 2027, will have its own outcome. A chair's summary whose themes 'do not constitute negotiated outcomes or consensus positions' is non-binding and stays 'Published (non-binding, current)'.
judgment.scope_reasoning: In scope without a note: the official outcome document of the UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance established by resolution 79/325, with a cluster on safe, secure and trustworthy AI.
